_comment: Client-side diagnostic samples consumed by DOCS/ARCHITECTURE_REPORT.html.
This file ships EMPTY on purpose: no real telemetry has been captured for this app yet,
and inventing numbers would make the dashboard lie. Until 'samples' is populated the
report renders its demo series and the header shows USING MOCK DATA = ON.
Append one object per page load to 'samples' (newest last) to switch it to real data.

_schema.capturedAt: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the sample
_schema.route: Blazor route the sample was taken on, e.g. /rap-roast
_schema.cls: number — cumulative layout shift score (0 is perfect, <0.1 is 'good')
_schema.errors: integer — JS + failed-fetch error count observed during the page's lifetime

_capture: PoRedoImage does not currently emit these metrics — there is no Web Vitals collector in
src/PoRedoImage.Client/wwwroot/js/. Adding one is the prerequisite for real charts.
A minimal collector needs: PerformanceNavigationTiming for pageLoadMs/domLatencyMs,
a PerformanceObserver on 'layout-shift' for cls, and window.onerror for errors.
